instruction.german: Read the information in the box. Then answer the questions.

staticText.text:
Build your potential | Understanding multiple choice

Multiple-choice questions are very common in exams. To do better with these kinds of questions, try to do the following:• Read the whole question carefully.• Find the part of the text that the question is about. Read that part again.• There is often one option which is more incorrect than the others. Eliminate that option first.• If you don’t know the answer, choose one option anyway. Do not leave the question blank.

configs.question: 1 Why do babies have more bones than adults?

additionalAnswers.answer: c Because babies’ bodies fix the bones.

configs.question: 2 When you blink, …
configs.correctAnswer: a you open and close both your eyes.

additionalAnswers.answer: a you open and close both your eyes.
b you open and close one eye.

configs.question: 3 What is the difference between O+ and AB- blood?
configs.correctAnswer: c One is more common than the other.

additionalAnswers.answer: a One is in 10% of your body.
c One is more common than the other.

configs.question: 4 What part of the body does the left side of the brain control?
5 When do you have more heartbeats per minute?

additionalAnswers.answer: c when you make the heart sign with your hands
